verdict.rationale: stagewise is a coding agent that can read, write, and modify files and run shell commands, scripts, and package managers. That plausibly covers running linters and tests and updating dependencies, but the docs never name any of the four tasks in the story. The support rests on the agent's own general file-editing and shell capabilities, with depth unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency-update workflows, plus any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Shell access — Run shell commands, scripts, and package managers
AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
